# Yagwa Tech Solutions — AI & LLM Reference Document

## Company Overview

Yagwa Tech Solutions is a full-spectrum digital solutions agency headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, founded in 2019. We help startups, SMEs, and enterprises across Kenya and Africa build, secure, and scale through technology.

Website: https://www.yagwatech.com
Contact: info@yagwatech.com
Phone: +254 117 722 077
Location: Nairobi, Kenya
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EAT

## Services

### Software & Systems Development
Custom web applications, SaaS platforms, mobile apps, API development, ERP and CRM systems, database design, and system integrations for businesses of all sizes.

### Cloud Services & Infrastructure
Cloud migration, AWS and Azure infrastructure, DevOps and CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), scalable hosting architecture, and managed cloud services.

### Cybersecurity & Compliance
Security audits, penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, data protection compliance (GDPR, Kenya Data Protection Act), endpoint security, and staff security training.

### UI/UX Design & Digital Branding
User interface design, user experience strategy, brand identity creation, logo design, brand guidelines, design systems, and digital asset production.

### Digital Marketing & SEO
Search engine optimization (SEO), AI engine optimization (AEO/GEO), social media marketing, Google Ads, content marketing, email campaigns, and analytics reporting.

### Business IT Consulting
IT strategy, technology roadmaps, digital transformation consulting, vendor selection, process automation, and ongoing IT advisory retainers.

### Data Analytics & Business Intelligence
Data pipelines, dashboard development, Power BI and custom BI tools, data warehousing, and analytics strategy for data-driven decision-making.

### Training & Capacity Building
Digital literacy workshops, corporate tech training, software onboarding programs, and community empowerment initiatives across Kenya.

## Key Projects

- **Rusinga Digital Empowerment Initiative (RDEI)** — Community digital literacy program training hundreds of residents on Rusinga Island, Kenya.
- **Business Matching Platform** — Brand identity and positioning for an investor–startup matchmaking platform.
- **Assets For Technology** — Centralized asset tracking system replacing disconnected spreadsheets for a multi-site technology firm.
- **Merger & Acquisition System** — Secure document management and audit-trail workflow for an M&A transaction.
- **Startup Funding Platform** — Application, evaluation, and disbursement tracking platform for a startup funding initiative.
